name: List All Community Association Violations
description: Returns Community Association (CA) violations that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter for CA violations updated at or after this date. All GET requests must include a filter for [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the association related to the violation(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA violation

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the association related to the violation(s)

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the CA violation was created

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the CA violation

responseFields.name: data[].InspectionDate
responseFields.description: The date of the CA unit's inspection

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The last time a CA violation's details were updated by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].MarkedForEscalation
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the CA violation was marked for escalation

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the CA violation

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: Indicates the current status of the CA violation

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the CA violation

responseFields.name: data[].ViolatedRuleId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA rule that was violated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
